text: To Steenbarger's hold: I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high on H1, ACT_NOW, no volume condition. A volume bar is not my test: day_vol is only a proxy to me and fill difficulty is not served (R5). A reaction on day_vol 0.24 is the quiet, normal reaction C8 says never to fear; W and D HH/HL, 1.07% under the 20-day high. The entry is the new high, not the volume. What would move me: a one-day fall of 1x atr_14d from the day's high, my translation of the danger signal (C7), or the new high failing to print.
